posts.title: Jolted and Jumbled: Riding in a Sedan Chair in the 18th Century
posts.description: If there is one form of transport that perhaps typifies the 18th century more than any other, it is a sedan chair. posts.title: To Tip or Not To Tip: A Victorian Traveller’s Perspective
posts.description: Like it or not, tipping is a big part of hospitality and the service industry. Debates about how much/whether to tip rumble on, but they are not new. Even in the 18th and 19th centuries, travellers were complaining about the amount of unwanted or unexpected extras they had to pay for.
